# Oldest players in men's UEFA European Championship history as of 2024
Oldest players at the men's UEFA European Championship 1960-2024
Ask AI
Last update: Jan 29, 2025
Region: Europe
[Statista Research Department](https://www.statista.com/aboutus/our-research-commitment/)
Survey time period: 1960 to 2024
As of 2024, Pepe was the oldest player to ever play in a men's European Championship game, being aged 41 years and 130 days when he featured for Portugal against France at EURO 2024. Lamine Yamal, the competition's [youngest ever player](https://www.statista.com/statistics/1455875/youngest-european-championship-players/), also featured in that tournament. Yamal was over 24 years younger than Pepe.
